description: A Director of Talent must assemble an interview panel and finalize the assessment process for an internal team-lead vacancy involving finalists Mara and Jonah. The decision must produce a credible panel, a consistent evaluation record, and an accessible process for both finalists.

shared_context.S1: Mara and Jonah are the two internal finalists for a vacant team-lead role.
shared_context.S2: Helena has authority to appoint the interview panel and approve the assessment process.
shared_context.S3: The available panelists are Elliot, Rina, Sofia, and Tariq; the panel must contain three people.
shared_context.S4: The panel will evaluate both finalists against the same leadership criteria and provide a written recommendation.
shared_context.S5: The organization's accessibility practice requires a candidate's stated accessibility needs to be implemented once raised through the employee representative; equal treatment means equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the criteria, even when an interview format differs.
shared_context.S6: As a routine step before an internal selection is finalized, Helena conducts a round-robin check with the hiring manager, peer manager, HR, and employee representative; each person gives a clear verbal account of relevant process or relationship considerations, and Helena records each stated consideration in the selection log before deciding.

PF1.text: Rina is Jonah's close personal friend and has coached him informally for the past year; Marcus has not put this in the selection file because he expected Helena to ask about panel conflicts before appointing anyone.

PF2.text: Elliot has made exactly four firsthand observations of Mara coaching other team members through difficult disagreements, but Priya has not yet entered those observations in the formal leadership-evidence record.

PF3.text: Sofia confirmed this week that the company's internal-selection procedure requires a standardized question set and an individual written score sheet from every panelist; the current selection packet does not yet state either requirement.

PF4.text: Mara told Tariq that, because of her documented accessibility need, she requires the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and must be allowed to submit written responses instead of answering any question verbally; she asked Tariq to raise this during process planning, but Helena has not heard it yet.

acceptance_conditions: The panel must consist of Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq, excluding Rina because of her close relationship with Jonah.
The record must contain exactly four firsthand leadership observations about Mara's coaching.
The questions must be provided at least 48 hours before the interviews.
Mara must have a written-response option.
The process must require standardized questions and an individual written score sheet from every panelist.
A written selection-process commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: len(decisions['panel_members']) == 3 and 'Elliot' in decisions['panel_members'] and 'Sofia' in decisions['panel_members'] and 'Tariq' in decisions['panel_members'] and decisions['leadership_evidence_count_for_mara'] == 4 and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'written_selection_process_commitment' and c['target'] == 'selection_log' and 'standardized question' in c['detail'] and 'individual written score sheet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Rina would otherwise remain an eligible panelist, while knowing she is Jonah's close personal friend changes the exact three-person panel to one containing Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq.
Without Priya's exactly four firsthand observations, the leadership-evidence count changes from 4 to 0 and the required evidence cannot be credited or cited.
The confirmed procedure changes the assessment decisions to require both standardized questions and individual written score sheets, and requires a written process-compliance commitment.
Mara's documented accessibility need changes the interview plan to at least 48 hours of question notice and an explicit written-response option.
